findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. These credentials can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, Lambda configuration readers, or function code/runtime access, enabling unauthorized AWS API access if valid.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known or newly discovered Node.js runtime vulnerabilities may remain unpatched in the execution environment.
